description: Renovate config — primary job is keeping the GitHub Action pins inside the bootstrap workflow *templates* current (issue #109). Renovate's stock github-actions manager already watches .github/workflows/*.yml in this repo; the customManager below extends that coverage to *.tmpl files under development/skills/bootstrap/templates/ where the action pins are baked into the workflow source we ship to downstream repos.

customManagers.description: Extract GitHub Action `uses:` pins from bootstrap workflow templates (*.tmpl). Stock github-actions manager only scans .yml/.yaml, so the templates that downstream repos render into their own workflows are otherwise invisible to drift detection.

packageRules.description: Batch every GitHub Action upgrade (both .yml and .tmpl) into one weekly PR so the user has a single review + merge for the whole action surface.
